svg.aria-label: Stiff-Legged Good Morning, Stand: Rest the bar on your upper back with your knees almost straight.
svg.title: Stiff-Legged Good Morning, Stand: Rest the bar on your upper back with your knees almost straight.

svg.aria-label: Stiff-Legged Good Morning, Hinge: Push your hips back and tip forward with a flat back.
svg.title: Stiff-Legged Good Morning, Hinge: Push your hips back and tip forward with a flat back.

svg.aria-label: Stiff-Legged Good Morning, Stretch: Stop when your hamstrings stretch and your back is still steady.
svg.title: Stiff-Legged Good Morning, Stretch: Stop when your hamstrings stretch and your back is still steady.

svg.aria-label: Stiff-Legged Good Morning, Stand up: Bring your hips forward to return to standing.
svg.title: Stiff-Legged Good Morning, Stand up: Bring your hips forward to return to standing.
